newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss ski cops stop snowboarders' mountain high.
newsitem.headline: Swiss ski cops stop snowboarders' mountain high.

text.p: Undercover Swiss police officers and customs agents have taken to the slopes to bust drug-taking snowboarders and skiers, police said on Wednesday.
Officers in civilian clothes are on patrol in the Alpine cantons of Valais and the Grisons to check whether winter athletes are smoking dope or taking other drugs, a police spokesman in Valais said.
They often nab drug smugglers between the smart Swiss resort of Zermatt and the Italian border in an area accessible only by skis in winter, he said.
Police in Berne said they seized ecstasy tablets during a raid on the slopes three weeks ago and were investigating several suspects.
